contentText: Spain got their World Cup redemption and their first win by comfortably beating Saudi Arabia 4-0. Belgium went down to 10 men after the eighth red card of the tournament was handed out. The Red Devils struggled against Iran, and that game ended on a dry tally of 0-0. The surprise of the evening played out in Miami, as Cape Verde managed to draw against Uruguay. Egypt finally got their hands on their first World Cup win as the Pharaohs won 3-1 against New Zealand. Plus, France get ready for their game against Iraq this Monday.
